mapper.select: SELECT * FROM song_tags WHERE song_id = #{songId} AND tag_id = #{tagId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO song_tags (song_id, tag_id, value, confidence, source, review_status, evidence_json, created_at) VALUES (#{songId}, #{tagId}, #{value}, #{confidence}, #{source}, #{reviewStatus}, #{evidenceJson}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE value = VALUES(value), confidence = VALUES(confidence), source = VALUES(source), review_status = VALUES(review_status), evidence_json = VALUES(evidence_json)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM song_tags WHERE song_id = #{songId} AND tag_id = #{tagId}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT st.song_id FROM song_tags st INNER JOIN songs s ON st.song_id = s.id WHERE s.status = 1
